scripts.build: prisma generate && prisma generate --schema=prisma-finance/schema.prisma && nest build && npm run verify:assets
scripts.verify:assets: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const f='dist/src/modules/contracts/templates/hire-purchase-contract.html';if(!fs.existsSync(f)){console.error('❌ Missing critical asset:',f);process.exit(1)}console.log('✓ Assets verified')"
